Theme 033 · Light, optics & texture

ASCII / Dither Resolve

Every image starts life as a coarse field of characters (. : - = + * # @) in ink on near-white. Resolution is the metaphor: the more Acme Pulse understands your metrics, the finer the grid gets, until it snaps into crisp vector UI. Except for one glyph cluster that refuses to resolve and stays coral.

4 · CTA0:36–0:45

The last glyphs retreat to the top and bottom edges as a fading band; the tagline resolves line by line (scramble → settle, 8 ms stagger) and Start free snaps crisp on the final downbeat.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Character-ramp field — a mono glyph grid ( .:-=+*#%@) that renders any image as brightness; the "not yet understood" state.
  • Resolution HUD — "RES 32 → 4 px" readout that makes progress legible without a progress bar.
  • Resolve seam — teal vertical wipe with a soft glow; ASCII on one side, clean UI on the other.
  • Hot glyph cluster — coral #@# characters that refuse to resolve; the anomaly.
  • Resolved pills — crisp white metric rows with green ticks; what healthy looks like.
  • Decision card — coral-ringed card rising out of the hot cluster, with Roll back / Acknowledge.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Resolution pull — cell size 32→4 px in steps(6), one step per beat at 120 BPM (0.5 s), so the image sharpens on the grid of the music.
  • Glyph scramble — each character cycles through the ramp before landing (60 ms/char, 8 ms stagger, seeded order).
  • Seam wipe — vertical mask sweeps left→right, expo.inOut 0.6 s, triggered exactly on the 0:08 drop.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

"Noise becomes clarity" is exactly what an anomaly agent does, and leaving one cluster unresolved points the eye at the problem for free. Risk: dense glyph fields turn to moiré under compression; keep hero cells ≥ 8 px.

Adapt to your product: Render a screenshot of your own UI through the character ramp, resolve it section by section, and leave your product's key finding as the last hot cluster.
